sources.title: Qwen3.8 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.

sources.title: Run Qwen 3.8 27B on AMD Ryzen™ AI Max Agentic PCs and Radeon ™ GPUs
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B brings the latest generation of the Qwen family to a model size well suited for local AI development. The Qwen 3.8 generation continues the focus on coding, real-world work, research, and long-horizon AI workloads, extending the rapid pace of innovation we are seeing across open AI.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B (2026): The Complete Guide to Qwen's New 27B Vision ...
sources.snippet: The complete 2026 guide to Qwen3.8-27B — Qwen's new 27B dense vision-language model with DeepSWE 42.2, Terminal Bench 73.0, OSWorld 84.3, native image/video input, 262K context, and Apache 2.0 weights.

sources.title: qwen3.8-27b - Cloudflare AI docs
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.8 27B is a 27-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model from Alibaba's Qwen family, designed for vision, efficient general-purpose text generation and agentic workloads.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is an AI model released by Qwen on Friday, Aug 14 2026, 11 days after Qwen3.8-Max. It is an open-weight model — the trained weights are available to download and run.
